concepts.name: Earnings Call Business Domain
concepts.description: Top-level anchor for cross-company business concepts observed in the cleaned earnings-call graph.

concepts.name: Company Role
concepts.description: A company's role in the AI infrastructure and cloud value chain.

concepts.name: AI / Cloud Infrastructure Value Chain
concepts.description: The infrastructure stack repeatedly observed in the cleaned data: cloud platforms, compute, data centers, networking, memory, storage, power, and semiconductor capacity.

concepts.name: Business Segment
concepts.description: A reportable or operating business segment, product family, or platform area.

concepts.name: Financial Metric
concepts.description: A quantitative or financial performance measure such as revenue, backlog, margin, or CapEx.

concepts.name: Risk / Pressure
concepts.description: Cost, margin, cash-flow, supply, FX, regulatory, macro, or execution pressure observed in earnings-call commentary.

concepts.name: Growth / Demand Driver
concepts.description: Demand, adoption, usage, monetization, or efficiency drivers cited by management as growth mechanisms.

concepts.name: Hyperscaler / Cloud Platform
concepts.description: Cloud platforms that convert AI demand into cloud services, AI services, backlog, and infrastructure CapEx.

concepts.name: AI Accelerator / Compute Vendor
concepts.description: Vendors that supply GPUs, accelerators, custom silicon, CPUs, and AI compute systems.

concepts.name: Foundry / Semiconductor Manufacturing
concepts.description: Manufacturing capacity and foundry services for leading-edge AI and cloud semiconductors.

concepts.name: Semiconductor Equipment
concepts.description: Equipment and process technology that enables leading-edge semiconductor capacity.

concepts.name: Memory / Storage Provider
concepts.description: Memory, storage, and data infrastructure providers supporting AI training, inference, and data growth.

concepts.name: Networking Infrastructure Provider
concepts.description: Networking, switching, routing, and interconnect providers that connect AI clusters and cloud data centers.

concepts.name: AI Server / Systems Provider
concepts.description: Server, systems, rack-scale, and infrastructure solution providers that package AI compute into deployable systems.

concepts.name: AI / Cloud Infrastructure
concepts.description: The compute, data center, accelerator, networking, memory, storage, power, and cloud capacity stack discussed across the cleaned company calls.

concepts.name: AI Workload Demand
concepts.description: Demand, usage, or workload growth attributed to AI products, models, inference, training, or AI-enabled services.

concepts.name: Training Compute
concepts.description: Compute used to train or pre-train large AI models.

concepts.name: Inference Compute
concepts.description: Compute used to serve AI models and agentic workloads in production.

concepts.name: Data Center / Compute Capacity
concepts.description: Capacity, compute, power, data center, GPU/TPU, or advanced packaging supply needed to serve AI/cloud demand.

concepts.name: Networking Fabric
concepts.description: Networking fabric, interconnect, routing, switching, and connectivity required for AI clusters and cloud platforms.

concepts.name: Memory Bandwidth / HBM
concepts.description: High-bandwidth memory and DRAM/NAND capacity used by AI accelerators and data platforms.

concepts.name: Storage Capacity
concepts.description: Storage capacity and data infrastructure used for AI data growth and enterprise workloads.

concepts.name: Power / Cooling Constraint
concepts.description: Power, cooling, and physical data center constraints that limit AI infrastructure deployment.

concepts.name: Cloud Platform Segment
concepts.description: Company cloud infrastructure/platform segments such as Google Cloud, Azure, AWS, OCI, or similar enterprise cloud businesses.

concepts.name: Enterprise AI Adoption
concepts.description: Enterprise/customer adoption of paid or deployed AI capabilities.

concepts.name: AI Product Monetization
concepts.description: Ways AI or cloud capabilities are monetized through cloud services, subscriptions, advertising, software, productivity, or enterprise offerings.

concepts.name: Infrastructure CapEx
concepts.description: Capital expenditures or infrastructure investment for AI, cloud, data centers, compute, or technical infrastructure.

concepts.name: Backlog / RPO
concepts.description: Contracted backlog, remaining performance obligation, or similar future-revenue visibility measure.

concepts.name: Revenue Growth
concepts.description: Revenue growth, acceleration, or revenue contribution metrics.

concepts.name: Operating Margin Pressure
concepts.description: Operating margin, P&L, gross margin, depreciation, or cost pressure from investment or operations.

concepts.name: Free Cash Flow Pressure
concepts.description: Free cash flow pressure caused by capex, working capital, or infrastructure investment cycles.

concepts.name: Supply Constraint
concepts.description: Supply chain, component, memory, capacity, or semiconductor constraints affecting delivery and demand capture.

concepts.name: Search AI Usage
concepts.description: AI-driven search usage, query growth, AI overviews, or AI search modes.

concepts.name: AI Efficiency
concepts.description: Hardware, model, or engineering efficiency that reduces latency or cost of AI responses.

concepts.name: Subscription Revenue
concepts.description: Paid subscription counts or subscription platform/device revenue.

concepts.name: Autonomous Mobility
concepts.description: Autonomous driving or robotaxi activity and expansion.

concepts.name: Foreign Exchange Impact
concepts.description: Foreign exchange headwinds or tailwinds and constant-currency effects.

concepts.name: Component / Input Cost Pressure
concepts.description: Component, input, supply-chain, manufacturing, or cost inflation pressure affecting margins or demand capture.

concepts.name: Regulatory / Compliance Risk
concepts.description: Regulatory, compliance, privacy, data governance, tariff, trade-policy, or geopolitical risk discussed in earnings commentary.

concepts.name: Consumer Demand
concepts.description: Consumer end-market demand, engagement, device demand, or consumer spending signals.

concepts.name: Pricing Power
concepts.description: Pricing power, price increases, ASP, or pricing strategy that supports revenue or margin outcomes.

concepts.name: Capital Allocation / Shareholder Returns
concepts.description: Capital allocation actions such as buybacks, dividends, shareholder returns, and balance-sheet capital deployment.
